response.text:
I can help, but I need a quick clarification and your explicit confirmation before doing any bulk changes.

Limitations: I can delete specific threads if you tell me which ones, but I don’t have a way (with the available connector) to run an automatic search and delete by criteria without you first confirming the matching messages. Safer option: I’ll give the exact Gmail search and step-by-step bulk-delete instructions you can run immediately — or, if you want me to perform the deletion for you, reply “Yes—delete all matching messages” after you confirm the exact search criteria below.

Please confirm which of these you want:
A) I delete all Atlassian notification emails from 2023 for you (you must reply “Yes—delete all matching messages” after confirming the exact search criteria below). Note: this will move messages to Trash (you can permanently delete later).
B) I give step-by-step instructions so you can review and delete them yourself (recommended).

If you choose A or want me to target a specific set, confirm the search criteria you approve. Suggested search (matches Atlassian senders from 2023):

from:(atlassian.com OR atlassian.net OR jira@ OR "no-reply@atlassian") after:2022/12/31 before:2024/01/01

If you want different scope, tell me:
- other sender addresses to include/exclude, or
- specific projects or subjects to keep,
- and whether you want permanent deletion (empty Trash) or just move to Trash/Archive.

If you pick B, here are the quick steps to run now:
1. Paste the search above into Gmail’s search box and press Enter.
2. Click the Select checkbox at top-left to select the page of results.
3. Click the link that appears: “Select all conversations that match this search.”
4. Click the Trash/Delete icon to move them to Trash.
5. (Optional) To permanently delete immediately: go to Trash and choose “Empty Trash now.”

Tell me A or B and confirm the exact criteria (or any exclusions).
